note: Submodule integrating memory_limit_policy with drupal/ai_agents. It registers 15 AiFunctionCall plugins (ids ai_agent:*) and ships an ai_agent config entity memory_limit_policy_agent (triage agent, max_loops 5) plus a ConstraintSchemaDiscovery service. Cases are grounded in the real function-call ids, the real ai_agent config entity, and the real end-state that create_memory_limit_policy produces (a memory_limit_policy entity). The hard case builds the same memory_limit_policy entity the create tool would, verified via the config entity, because the eval harness cannot drive a live LLM.

evals.prompt: The memory_limit_policy_ai_agents submodule exposes AI function-call tools for managing memory limit policies. Name the tool an AI agent would call to create a new policy and one it would call to add a constraint to a policy.
evals.expected_output: It registers AiFunctionCall tools with ids like ai_agent:create_memory_limit_policy (creates a policy) and ai_agent:add_policy_constraint (appends a constraint). Other tools include list_memory_limit_policies, get_constraint_schema, edit/delete/enable/disable/set_policy_weight, remove_policy_constraint and set_module_settings.

evals.prompt: What permission do the modification tools in memory_limit_policy_ai_agents require, and what Drupal contrib module must be installed for this submodule to work?
evals.expected_output: The modification function calls check the 'administer memory limit policies' permission before acting, and the submodule depends on the ai_agents module (drupal/ai_agents).

evals.prompt: Does memory_limit_policy_ai_agents ship a ready-made AI agent, and what kind of agent is it?
evals.expected_output: Yes: it installs an ai_agent config entity with id memory_limit_policy_agent (config ai_agents.ai_agent.memory_limit_policy_agent), a triage agent (triage_agent: true) with max_loops 5, wired to all the memory-limit-policy function-call tools.

evals.prompt: This site has the memory_limit_policy_ai_agents submodule enabled, which installs an ai_agent named 'memory_limit_policy_agent'. Inspect the live configuration and report the value of its max_loops setting.
evals.expected_output: max_loops is 9 on this site (config ai_agents.ai_agent.memory_limit_policy_agent, key max_loops). The shipped default is 5.

evals.prompt: The memory_limit_policy_ai_agents 'create_memory_limit_policy' tool creates a memory_limit_policy entity. Produce the same end state directly: create an enabled memory limit policy with machine id 'mlp_ai_exec', label 'AI created', memory 640M and weight 0 (no constraints). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create the memory_limit_policy config entity mlp_ai_exec with memory '640M', status TRUE, weight 0 and empty policy_constraints — exactly what ai_agent:create_memory_limit_policy's execute() does (storage->create([...])->save()).
